text: Dornot, pronounced [dɔʁno] in French and known as Dorningen in German, was a former commune located in the Moselle department of north-eastern France. On 1 January 2016, it was incorporated into the newly formed commune of Ancy-Dornot. The village lies on the left bank of the Moselle River, and its recorded population in 2022 was 162. In September 1944, American General George S. Patton commanded Walton Walker's XX Corps in a failed attempt to cross the Moselle at Dornot, resulting in intense combat and a defensive victory for the German forces. This event is part of the Lorraine Campaign. This Arrondissement of Metz geographical article is currently a stub and can be expanded with additional information on Wikipedia.
